commands.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(uname -s)" = Darwin
export GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0
WORK="$(mktemp -d /tmp/bloomml-branch-clean.XXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$WORK"' EXIT
git clone --quiet --branch main https://github.com/MichalMatu/bloomml.git "$WORK/source"
cd "$WORK/source"
EXPECTED_MAIN="8ed884a56c91fcd8650796cdb3db7ea4cbf37312"
EXPECTED_RESEARCH="73de11be282d40d03767275cc6a0891e58ed23f8"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED_MAIN"
git fetch --quiet origin "+refs/heads/research/simulator-fidelity-kaggle-20261103:refs/remotes/origin/research/simulator-fidelity-kaggle-20261103"
test "$(git rev-parse refs/remotes/origin/research/simulator-fidelity-kaggle-20261103)" = "$EXPECTED_RESEARCH"
git merge-base --is-ancestor "$EXPECTED_RESEARCH" "$EXPECTED_MAIN"
git merge-base --is-ancestor "5e4db5af736e9c18d69d451496694fa6aff11743" "$EXPECTED_MAIN"
python3 - <<'PY'
import subprocess
def git(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git',*args], text=True).strip()
def entries(ref):
    return dict(line.split(' ',2)[-1].split('\t',1)[::-1] for line in git('ls-tree','-r',ref).splitlines())
# git ls-tree values are "<mode> <type> <sha>\t<path>"; map path -> "<mode> <type> <sha>".
main=entries('HEAD')
research=entries('73de11be282d40d03767275cc6a0891e58ed23f8')
common=entries('51c90cd3290efde230f0c929e93aaf620e0de106')
conflicts={'docs/CURRENT_STATUS.md','docs/PROJECT_ROADMAP.md','docs/README.md','docs/simulator/RESEARCH_STATUS.md','docs/simulator/MPC_ROADMAP.md','docs/simulator/KAGGLE_EXECUTION.md'}
changed=[p for p in research if research.get(p)!=common.get(p)]
lost=[p for p in changed if p not in conflicts and main.get(p)!=research.get(p)]
assert len(changed)==75, len(changed)
assert not lost, lost
assert all(main[p] for p in conflicts)
for p in ('notebooks/BloomML_Kaggle_R4_Stress.ipynb','tools/ml/mpc/optimizer.py','tools/ml/physics/growbox_dynamics.py','tests/test_mpc_devices.py'):
    assert main[p]==research[p], p
print('RESEARCH_ANCESTRY_AND_BLOBS|PASS|'+str(len(changed))+'|'+str(len(changed)-len(conflicts)))
PY
git diff --quiet 5e4db5af736e9c18d69d451496694fa6aff11743 HEAD -- src/ lib/ components/ config/ tools/panel/ web/ schemas/
echo 'PRODUCTION_CODE_UNCHANGED|PASS'
python3 -m compileall -q tools/ml/mpc tools/ml/physics tools/ml/kaggle_gpu_r2_runner.py tools/ml/kaggle_r4_stress_runner.py
echo 'RESEARCH_COMPILEALL|PASS'
PYTHONPATH=. python3 -m unittest -q tests.test_mpc_devices tests.test_mpc_optimizer_mock tests.test_mpc_baselines tests.test_mpc_device_responses tests.test_mpc_physics_integration tests.test_mpc_lab_observability tests.test_mpc_shadow_contract tests.test_mpc_scenario_catalog
echo 'MPC_UNITTEST|PASS'
PYTHONPATH=. python3 -m unittest -q tests.test_external_greenhouse_benchmark tests.test_wur_external_benchmark
echo 'DATASET_UNITTEST|PASS'
git status --short | grep . && { echo 'WORKTREE_NOT_CLEAN'; exit 83; } || true
echo 'CHECKOUT_CLEAN|PASS'
REMOTE="$(git ls-remote --heads origin 'refs/heads/research/simulator-fidelity-kaggle-20261103' | awk '{print $1}')"
test "$REMOTE" = "$EXPECTED_RESEARCH"
echo 'RESEARCH_TIP_VERIFIED_BEFORE_DELETE|PASS'
if git push --quiet origin --delete research/simulator-fidelity-kaggle-20261103; then
  echo 'DELETE_TRANSPORT|git_push'
elif command -v gh >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  gh api -X DELETE repos/MichalMatu/bloomml/git/refs/heads/research/simulator-fidelity-kaggle-20261103 >/dev/null
  echo 'DELETE_TRANSPORT|gh_api'
else
  echo 'DELETE_TRANSPORT|NO_WRITE_AUTH'
  exit 84
fi
test -z "$(git ls-remote --heads origin 'refs/heads/research/simulator-fidelity-kaggle-20261103')"
echo 'RESEARCH_BRANCH_DELETED|PASS'
printf 'PRESERVED_MAIN_SHA|%s\n' "$EXPECTED_MAIN"
